title: Host elements
description: Every component instance is associated with a host element that matches the component's selector.

blocks.text: This guide assumes you've already read the [Essentials Guide](essentials). Read that first if you're new to Angular.
Every component instance is associated with a **host element**— the DOM element that matches the component's selector. The contents of a component's template are rendered inside this element.
In Angular, you can apply attributes, CSS classes, styles, and event listeners directly to the host element by using the `host` property of the `@Component` decorator:
